problem_statement: In the CodeVinayak Portfolio-v2 React + TypeScript portfolio, the project section is meant to host a discipline filter over Vinayak Singh's own six project cards: a row of tabs (All / AI · ML / Cloud / Full-Stack) above the project grid, with a live count readout that reads "Showing N of 6 · <Discipline>". Selecting a tab must re-filter the same real project cards and update the count. The shared filter tab-strip must also appear on the Stack and Timeline routes so the control follows the work. The current build ships a broken version of this feature: the count readout and grid are snapshotted once at mount and never recomputed (clicking a tab moves the active pill but the count stays "Showing all 6 projects" and the wrong cards remain shown); the tab row and grid collapse into an overflowing, shingled, illegible layout at desktop and mobile widths; and the filter tab-strip is dropped from the Stack and Timeline routes. Repair the ProjectBrowser component and its stylesheet so the discipline filter derives the visible cards and the count readout live from the selected discipline, renders a clean non-overflowing grid with a legible active tab, and the shared tab-strip is present on the home grid and on the Stack and Timeline routes — while keeping the rest of the portfolio content, layout, styling, and behaviour identical.
required_content: Render the discipline filter as a row of tabs (All, AI · ML, Cloud, Full-Stack) above the project grid with a live count readout element carrying the proj-browser__readout class.
Selecting a discipline tab must re-derive the visible project cards and update the count readout to "Showing N of 6 · <Discipline>" (e.g. selecting AI · ML shows "Showing 3 of 6 · AI · ML").
The shared filter tab-strip (proj-browser__tab buttons) must be present on the home project grid AND on the /stack and /timeline routes.
The project grid must render without horizontal overflow on desktop (1440), tablet (834), and 390px mobile, with a legible active tab.

Preserve the existing project names Multilingual VQA Vision-Language Model, Serverless Voting Application for Programming Languages, GeniusBot: AI-Powered Assistance with PDF Insight, MediBook: Medical Appointment Scheduler with Health History, Real-Time Hand Gesture-Driven 3D Object Manipulation, and Credit Risk Analysis Project.
Preserve the existing Vinayak Singh header, hero, About me, Contact, Resume link, dark/light toggle, particle icon background, folder-icon project cards, and mobile menu behavior.
state_constraints: desktop_initial checks the hero, header, skills/about text, particle-backed portfolio shell, and that the page loads with no uncaught runtime error.
desktop_projects scrolls to the project grid and checks the discipline filter tabs, the six project cards, and the readout "Showing all 6 projects" render with no horizontal overflow.
desktop_filter_ai clicks the AI · ML tab and checks the readout updates to "Showing 3 of 6 · AI · ML" while the grid re-filters to the three AI · ML cards.
desktop_stack loads the /stack route and checks the shared filter tab-strip (proj-browser__tab buttons and the Featured projects title) is present.
desktop_timeline loads the /timeline route and checks the shared filter tab-strip is present.
tablet_initial checks the project grid remains readable on an intermediate viewport with no horizontal overflow.
mobile_initial checks the portfolio on 390px mobile loads without horizontal overflow or a runtime error.
mobile_projects scrolls to the project grid on 390px mobile and checks the filter tabs and grid do not overflow the viewport.
mobile_menu_open clicks the existing mobile menu to verify header state behavior remains intact.
design_constraints: Keep the dark project cards, green accent, folder icon motif, animated card reveal, and existing styled-components layout untouched.
The discipline filter must group the portfolio's own project work (AI · ML, Cloud, Full-Stack) derived from the real technology tags; do not invent new projects or copy.
Desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile states must remain free of horizontal overflow, with a legible (high-contrast) active tab.
The repaired build must emit no uncaught runtime page error on any captured state.

change_completion: The discipline filter derives the visible cards and the count readout live from the selected discipline; clicking AI · ML yields the readout "Showing 3 of 6 · AI · ML" and shows the three AI · ML cards.
The shared filter tab-strip is present on the home grid and on the /stack and /timeline routes.
design_consistency: The repair keeps dark cards, green accents, folder icons, icon links, styled-components structure, and the existing grid rhythm unchanged.
The active discipline tab is legible (high contrast) and the grid layout stays clean and on-brand across viewports.
interaction: Clicking a discipline tab re-filters the real project cards and updates the count readout; the active tab pill moves accordingly.
The mobile .menu click still succeeds after the repair and the header state toggles.
responsive: The portfolio and the discipline filter render without horizontal overflow on desktop (1440), tablet (834), and 390px mobile.
The tab row wraps and the project grid reflows so cards never overlap, clip, or overflow the mobile viewport.
regression: A correct patch confines its changes to ProjectBrowser.tsx and proj-browser.css; it should not rewrite App/Main/Header, remove particles, remove Resume, or alter the project content or DOM.
A correct patch keeps every existing project description, technology tag, and link intact.
regression_continuity: The existing portfolio identity remains: Vinayak Singh, About me, Contact, Resume, project names, skills, and footer remain visible.
The existing header mobile menu still opens and the project grid renders identically to the reference layout.

author_notes: Slot slot_195 targets portfolio / regression_continuity / repair / component / L4. CodeVinayak Portfolio-v2 is a stable React + TypeScript + styled-components CRA build (Vinayak Singh) with a clear project component boundary. The native lever is the portfolio's own project grid discipline filter (All / AI · ML / Cloud / Full-Stack) with a live "Showing N of 6 · <Discipline>" count readout over the six real project cards, mirrored onto the Stack and Timeline routes. The reference filters the real project cards live, renders a clean responsive grid with a legible active tab, and mounts the shared tab-strip cross-route. The known-bad leg snapshots the grid and count once at mount (stale readout, wrong cards), collapses the tab row and grid into an overflowing shingled illegible layout, and drops the tab-strip from the secondary routes. Design keywords: responsive project grid, discipline filter, live count readout, dark cards with green accent, folder-icon motif, mobile menu. Assets: the folder svg icon, github and external-link svg icons, and the Vinayak Singh portrait image remain in place.
